verdict.rationale: Kong's gateway code is hosted in a public GitHub repository (github.com/Kong/kong), which other Kong repos and docs reference, and the go-kong item mentions an OSS edition of Kong Gateway. That makes the source readable, but no evidence item names the license or confirms it is an open license. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement (e.g. a LICENSE file or docs naming it), clarity on which components are open versus Enterprise-only, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
